_note: SYNTHETIC POC DATA. Thresholds, deadlines and region lists are indicative (researched Oct 2026) and MUST be confirmed by counsel before enforce mode.

rules.description: EU personal/payment data hosted outside the EEA requires adequacy or a valid transfer tool (SCC/IGA/BCR) covering destination, purpose and data class
Transfers of EU personal data to third countries require adequacy or an appropriate safeguard in force
Indian payment system data must be stored only in India
rules.sourceRef: RBI circular on Storage of Payment System Data (2018) + FAQs

rules.description: Copies of Indian payment data processed abroad must carry a return-to-India deadline
rules.sourceRef: RBI Storage of Payment System Data FAQs (processing abroad)

rules.description: Raw Indian payment data may not be exported except for foreign processing with a return deadline
rules.sourceRef: RBI Storage of Payment System Data FAQs

rules.description: Personal data may be transferred abroad unless the destination is restricted by Central Government notification
Singapore customer information hosted outside Singapore requires a documented MAS outsourcing / cloud risk assessment covering the location
rules.sourceRef: MAS Guidelines on Outsourcing; MAS TRM Guidelines

rules.description: Personal data transferred out of Singapore requires comparable protection (contract / BCR / IGA)
Important data and sensitive personal information of the (simulated) China entity must be stored in mainland China
rules.sourceRef: DSL Art. 31; PIPL Art. 40; Network Data Security Management Regulations

rules.description: Outbound personal information requires the route determined by volume/sensitivity/important-data (exemption, standard contract/certification, or CAC security assessment)
rules.sourceRef: PIPL Art. 38; Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows (Mar 2024); Certification Measures (eff. 1 Jan 2026)

rules.description: Data stored in China may not be provided to foreign judicial or law-enforcement authorities without approval of the competent Chinese authority
Unclassified assets are treated as restricted (unknown = restricted) and must remain in their home cell
Transfers containing no personal or regulated data (after approved transform) are permitted
Aggregate exports must meet minimum cell size (k-anonymity threshold)
Erasure is deferred while a legal hold or statutory retention period applies
rules.sourceRef: GDPR Art. 17(3)(b); SEC 17a-4; local record-keeping rules
